CollectionDesc.SourceString: 嵌有惠比寿鳞片的纯金雕像，比起它本身的价值，更因为一道传言：「持有这尊雕像就可以获得比肩德沃夏克家的财运。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A golden statue inlaid with Ebisu's scales. They say its bearer may one day possess riches worthy of the Dvořák name.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: Pendragon，雷加利亚对未来探索的最新力作，用科技缔造新的超跑传奇。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Pendragon. Regalia's latest masterpiece for future exploration, forging new supercar legends with cutting-edge technology.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 小小一颗却价值连城。世间万物转瞬即逝，但钻石始终是钻石。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Small in size, yet priceless in value. All things in this world are fleeting, but diamonds are forever.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「方盒科技」新型研发产品，完全打开后能当被子盖。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Cubox Technologies' latest invention: a foldable screen so big, it doubles as a blanket when opened.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 为安魂曲量身定制的户外睡眠用手提箱，内置安魂曲专用的抱枕与毯子，安魂曲只要见到就会想要钻进去。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A portable outdoor sleeping case custom-made for Lacrimosa, complete with a pillow and blanket made just for her. The moment she sees it, she'll want to crawl inside.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 身形细长的大型鱼类。银色的身体上带有红橙蓝相间的斑纹，较为罕见，常被误认为是龙的幼崽，因此对它也有「龙宫使者」的称号。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A large fish with a long, slender body. Its silver scales are traced with interwoven stripes of red, orange, and blue. Rarely seen, it is often mistaken for a young dragon, earning it the folk title of "Messenger of the Dragon Palace."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 这张照片，是你们之间仅剩的回忆纽带了……你没哭。只是眼睛里有点进雪。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: This photograph is the only connection left between you… You're not crying. There's just some snow in your eyes.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「方盒科技」新型研发产品，完全打开后能当被子盖。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Cubox Technologies' latest invention: a foldable screen so big, it doubles as a blanket when opened.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 每一格仅有一口的九格食盒，带来极致的味蕾盛宴。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Nine tiny bites, nine little surprises—a miniature feast for the taste buds.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 由塔吉多仿照「副手」制作的滑翔伞，拥有外观专利的「柯林斯一代目」表示勉勉强强有点像吧，并慷慨地允许「副手的副手」加入家族。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A paraglider made by Taygedo in imitation of the Underboss. "The Ichi-daime of the Coluccis" with its patented appearance grudgingly admits there's a slight resemblance, and generously allows the "Underboss-of-the-Underboss" to join the family.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「珠宝不语，却比任何语言都打动人心。」某位著名作家如是说。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: "Jewelry speaks no words, yet it moves the heart more than any language." So said a famous writer.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 天青色的莲花自瓶底绽放，如此百年。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Sky-blue lotuses bloom from the vase's base, as they have for hundreds of years.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 海水，眼泪，亦或是海的泪？
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Seawater, tears, or perhaps the sea's own tears?

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 印有「迈达斯科技」标志的U盘，里面记录了一项图特研究所持有的异能专利。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A flash drive bearing the Midas Technologies logo. Stored inside is a superpower patent owned by the Thoth Research Institute.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 原本似乎是某种器物的核心，如今却失去了最初的辉光。孤独的秘藏被看守在收藏室的深处，期盼着终有一日能被安置到正确的地方。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Once the core of an unknown device, now stripped of its original glow. Guarded deep within the collection vault, this lonely relic waits for the day it can be placed where it truly belongs.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 据说曾是一位公爵所珍视的「几何」系列收藏品中的一件，然而其余保留下来的被某位商人砸碎，以此期望孤品能成为无价之宝。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Rumored to be one of the treasured pieces from a duke's "Geometric" series collection. However, the remaining pieces were destroyed by a merchant who hoped that making it a one-of-a-kind item would turn it into a priceless treasure.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 形似泪滴的宝石，不知是谁曾为之落泪？
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A teardrop-shaped gem. Whose sorrow gave it this form?

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 咔滋——咔滋——咔滋——停……停不下来！麻烦，请，拜托！再来一碗吧！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Crunch crunch crunch… Can't… Can't stop! Please, I'm begging you! One more bowl!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 休闲型卡丁车，操纵灵活，强劲的引擎搭载氮气加速系统，让你充分感受到速度的乐趣！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A hobbyist go-kart with superb handling and a powerful engine fitted with a nitrous acceleration system—put pedal to the metal and feel the wind on your face!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 历经时间洗礼后依旧寒光凛冽的长刀，出鞘之时连天上的星光都避其锋芒。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A long blade that retains its cold, piercing gleam even after the trials of time. When unsheathed, even the stars in the sky shy away from its sharp edge.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 乔望尼先生根据自身形象打造的纯金小雕像，价值如同他的身价般高昂的同时，连那副自信张扬的神态都栩栩如生。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A solid-gold statuette cast in Mr. Giovanni's likeness—worth as much as his fortune, right down to that cocky, self-satisfied expression. Its rendering is almost uncanny.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: DSD潮玩店新推出的异象玩具。在捏造时注入自身了解，即可还原实物材质与光泽的橡皮泥。很适合捏成宝石的样子做装饰，不过要注意摸上去还是软的！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A new Anomaly toy from DSD POP. Infuse your understanding into molding and restore the texture and gloss of real materials with this rubber clay. It's perfect for shaping into gem-like decorations, but keep in mind that it remains soft to the touch!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 很大的饼，光是看着就觉得饱了。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An enormous flatbread. Just looking at it makes you feel full.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 金黄色的大型鱼类。鳞片光泽艳丽，游姿优雅，体型虽大但脾性极为温和，通常象征着富贵吉祥，人气居高不下，具有相当高的观赏和收藏价值。可在鱼缸饲养或车尾展示。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A large fish with golden-yellow coloring. Its scales have a brilliant, lustrous sheen, and it swims with elegance. Despite its size, it is extremely gentle. Often seen as a symbol of wealth and good fortune, this fish is highly popular and holds considerable value as both an ornamental fish and a collector's prize.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 当生命变得可以衡量，它又将价值几何？
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: If life can be measured, what value does it still hold?

CollectionDesc.SourceString:
会变色的软体动物。
在海中，有时候椰子壳里不一定是甘甜的椰子水。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString:
A color-changing mollusk.
In the sea, a coconut shell may hold something far stranger than sweet coconut water.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 古色古香的花瓶，不管你是考古学家还是窃贼，搬运时请务必轻拿轻放。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An antique vase with classical charm. Whether you're an archaeologist or a thief, please handle with care when carrying it.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 以「邂逅~银月圆舞会」中的高人气角色浅绯祈为原型设计的模型，深受粉丝喜爱。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A model designed based on the popular character Asahi Inori from "Fleeting—A Gala under the Moonlight", beloved by fans.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 据说是每时每刻都在向外发射某种电波的贵重仪器，对于维特海默值的波动异常敏锐，极大地方便了学者们对于一些可能存在未知异象的神秘领域的探索。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A high-value instrument rumored to emit constant electromagnetic waves. Highly sensitive to fluctuations in the Wertheimer Index, it has become an indispensable tool for scholars probing regions where unknown Anomalies may lurk.

CollectionName.LocalizedString: Sea Salt Deep in the Heart

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 在杯口沾上少许海盐，轻微的咸涩能让酒的酸甜更显绵长。这是翳过去最喜欢的喝法……尽管他现在觉得有点不健康。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The glass's rim is coated with a touch of sea salt. The subtle saltiness enhances the drink's sweet and sour notes, making them linger longer. This was Skia's favorite way to drink it in the past… though he now thinks it's a bit unhealthy.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 精雕细琢的筷子，不知道用这双筷子吃饭会不会让食物更美味一些？
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A pair of finely carved chopsticks with a vine pattern. Food might just taste better when eaten with them.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「珠宝不语，却比任何语言都打动人心。」某位著名作家如是说。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: "Jewelry speaks no words, yet it moves the heart more than any language." So said a famous writer.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 剔透的珍珠项链，颗颗圆润的珍珠好似海底月华，就连传说中人鱼的眼泪也无法与之媲美。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A lustrous pearl necklace, each perfectly round pearl gleaming like moonlight on the ocean floor. Even the legendary tears of mermaids couldn't compare.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 由「管家」大卫先生驱动的次世代新概念载具。在下次迭代中，我们预计将其改为燃料驱动，使用大小相等的四轮，以及更安全的封闭轿厢。这是载具界的一次重大突破！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Next-gen concept vehicle driven by Mr. David, the Butler. Future models will use fuel, four equal wheels, and a safer enclosed cabin—a major leap in vehicle design!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 结实耐用的沙袋。外形可爱吸睛，是锻炼身体的不错选择，兼有晾衣服，猫爬架等多种功能，娜娜莉似乎对它情有独钟。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A sturdy and durable punching bag. Its cute and eye-catching appearance makes it a great choice for exercise, with multiple other functions including clothes drying and cat climbing. Nanally seems particularly fond of it.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 还在为手机型号不同而烦恼吗？「方盒科技」全新技术，解决一切适配问题。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Worried about phone compatibility? Cubox Technologies has a new solution for every device.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 唯有「舞会皇后」才能佩戴的冠冕，只是——「欲戴其冠，必承其重。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A crown that only the "Ball Queen" may wear, but remember—"Heavy is the head that wears the crown."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「贵族」只是这场盛会的入场券，黄金铸就的权杖也不过是阿拉克涅小姐的垫脚石。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Nobility is merely an entry ticket to this grand celebration, and even a scepter forged of gold is nothing more than a stepping stone for Arachne.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 蕴含了没能被说出口的某句话的花种，在将其栽培到绽放之前无从知晓语义为何。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A flower seed containing words left unspoken, its meaning unknown until it blooms into full blossom.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 气象藤的一枝，可以用来预测明天的天气。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A branch from the Weather Vine, said to predict tomorrow's weather.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 华美的宝石项链，入目的那一刻，会觉得世间最动人的存在也正该如此。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A gorgeous gemstone necklace. The moment it catches your eye, you'll feel that this is exactly what the most breathtaking thing in the world should look like.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 审判猎手为暴走都市献上忠诚！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The Judge Hunter pledges loyalty to Raging City!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 转动它，窥见世界的本质。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Turn it, and glimpse the true nature of the world.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 所谓的英雄，就是要战胜一切邪恶！心猎铁骑L1系列手办，绝赞售卖中！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A true hero is one who defeats all evildoers! Kokoro Rider L1 series figurine, now for sale!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 所谓的英雄，就是要肩负一切责任！心猎铁骑L2系列手办，绝赞售卖中！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A true hero is one who shoulders everything! Kokoro Rider L2 series figurine, now for sale!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 所谓的英雄，就是要守护一切梦想！心猎铁骑L3系列手办，绝赞售卖中！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A true hero is one who protects every dream! Kokoro Rider L3 series figurine, now for sale!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「我有辞乡剑，玉锋堪截云。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: "I bear a sword of farewell, its jade edge cleaving the clouds."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「襄阳走马客，意气自生春。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: "A wandering rider, carrying the spirit of spring wherever he goes."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 书写流畅，极致续航，创作理应随心所欲。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Smooth writing. Exceptional battery life. Creation, made effortless.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 轻巧便捷，超强储能，更配有太阳能充电功能。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A lightweight, portable power bank with high-capacity storage and solar charging.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 还在为数据线长度不够而烦恼吗？「方盒科技」自由数据线，想要多长就有多长。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Tired of short cables? Cubox Technologies' Freewire Cable extends to whatever length you need.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 来吧，聆听骑士的轰鸣，它自地平线而来。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Listen—the knight's roar rises from beyond the horizon.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 不会发光的星星，好像有点可惜。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A star that doesn't shine — such a pity.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 写在纸上的秘密终有被发现的一天，写在心底的可不会。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Secrets written on paper will eventually be discovered, but those written in the heart never will.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 一口下去，满满的幸福。全都要才是正确的选择。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: One bite, pure happiness. When everything tastes this good, choosing it all is the only answer.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 又该如何表达？只能像植物一样沉默。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A quiet answer to feelings left unspoken, like petals falling without a sound.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「方盒科技」智能手表，帮您记录每一天。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A Cubox Technologies smartwatch that tracks each day by your side.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 落日色的粉红珍珠，像是把太阳握在手里。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A pearl glowing with the pink of sunset, as if a fragment of the sun rests in your palm.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 光从一端进入，于是彩虹诞生了。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A curious cube that turns a single beam of light into a blooming rainbow.

CollectionName.SourceString: 莓果总汇奶油长棍面包

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 专业护膝，十五级坡度调节，每天坚持十分钟，感受运动的乐趣。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A professional treadmill with 15 incline settings. Just 10 minutes a day is enough to feel the joy of exercise.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 很久以前，人们就连看到模糊的星星都会发出惊叹。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Long ago, people would gasp in wonder at even the faintest glimpse of the stars.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 家用动感单车，超强减震，智能调阻，全新自发电系统，一踩即可享受健康时光。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A home exercise bike with excellent shock absorption, smart resistance control, and a new self-generating power system. Start pedaling and enjoy a moment of healthy movement.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 画中人的面容已经模糊不清，却依然得见花朵的娇艳。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The face in the painting has blurred with time, yet the flowers still bloom in vivid detail.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 经典款式的数码相机，常年入选呗果上的摄影入门装备推荐榜前十，颇受摄影发烧友的青睐。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A classic digital camera that consistently ranks among Bagel's Top 10 beginner photography picks. Well-loved by photography enthusiasts for its reliability and image quality.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 击打或摩擦易燃物，会燃起紫色火焰，遇水也无法浇灭。燃烧充分后，火焰自行消散。「给你的伙伴们变个戏法吧！」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Strike or rub it against something flammable to ignite a purple flame that water can't extinguish. Once it burns out, the flame fades on its own. "Show your friends a little trick!"

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 一样脆脆的薯饼，可惜还不够善良。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Crispy, golden hash browns. Sadly, their heart isn't quite as golden.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 不知前路、难以落地的盲目乌鸦衔着的宝石，无人知晓它们来自何方。有传言说捡到「谕石」的人会被厄运缠身，倘若不小心捡到也不用在意，位于各地的魔女之家中的「魔女」小姐能够消弭这份厄运。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString:
Gems, carried by blind, lost ravens that are unable to land, their origins unknown to all.
Rumors say that those who pick up Oracle Stones will be struck by misfortune… Though, don't worry if you happen to find one; the mysterious lady from the Witch's House can dispel your misfortune.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 无论乐坛的潮流如何发展，总有人在听上个世纪的流行金曲。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: No matter how music trends evolve, there'll always be people listening to the golden hits of the last century.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 以纳库佩达为原型设计的玩偶，造型活灵活现，对着它扔硬币的话会实现愿望吗……？
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A doll designed based on Nacupeda, with a vivid and lifelike appearance. Would throwing coins at it grant your wishes…?

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 雪和雪中的华尔兹，在漫天飞白中不停地旋转，旋转。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Within its crystal sphere, snow drifts endlessly as a silent waltz turns beneath a white winter sky.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 只要能找回孩子们……
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: If only I could find the children…

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 发间盈盈蓝。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A delicate hairpin that leaves a touch of vivid blue among the hair.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 自动排序，自动充电，更贴心的学习伙伴。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A thoughtful study companion that sorts your pens and keeps them charged, all on its own.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 古韵悠长的青花瓷碗，在遥远的过去曾作为不可缺少的日用品构建着人们热气腾腾的生活。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A blue and white porcelain bowl with a timeless, classical charm. In the distant past, it served as an indispensable everyday item, a part of people's warm and vibrant lives.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 相当具有研究价值的长刀，历史上曾无数次在战场中所向披靡，而现在它唯一所剩只有古旧的寂静。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A long blade of considerable research value that was once invincible on countless battlefields throughout history. Now, all that remains is an ancient and quiet stillness.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 青釉凝露，温润如雨后初晴的天空。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Its glaze gleams with the softness of dew, clear and gentle as the sky after rain.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 珍贵的纯金项链，款式独特，光泽幽雅，戴上它时仿佛是融化的月光蜿蜒在颈上。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A precious necklace crafted from pure gold. Its unique design and gentle sheen make it feel like melted moonlight flowing along the neck.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 古色古香的花瓶，不管你是考古学家还是窃贼，搬运时请务必轻拿轻放。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An antique vase with classical charm. Whether you're an archaeologist or a thief, please handle with care when carrying it.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 丰富的焦糖味夹杂着恰到好处的苦涩，回味带有一丝橡木的香气。向你致敬，我的朋友，向我们生活中的每一场战斗致敬。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Rich caramel flavor mixed with just the right amount of bitterness, with a hint of oak in the aftertaste. Here's to you, my friend, and to every battle in our lives.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 于洄游途中被捕捉的一旗，饲养在小小的水缸里。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Caught mid-journey, this bannerfish now lives in a tiny aquarium.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 必不可少的家具摆件。以兔耳造型搭配趣味按钮，是卡通与现代科技的完美结合，适合装点创意场所。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An essential furniture ornament. Featuring a rabbit ear design with playful buttons, it's a perfect blend of cartoon and modern technology, suitable for decorating creative spaces.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「方盒科技」无边平板，学习游玩都是好帮手。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A borderless tablet from Cubox Technologies. A reliable companion for studying, gaming, and everything in between.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 一口喝下去就吃掉了太阳。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A bright, golden treat that tastes like swallowing the morning sun in one gulp.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 祂目视，祂允诺，以金钱填满欲望的沟壑，放还吧，祂低语。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: It beholds, It promises, filling the chasms of desire with wealth. Let go, It whispers.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 想成为不一样的存在，想像他们一样闪耀光辉。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Wanting to become something different, wanting to shine brilliantly like them.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 那是干枯眼眶中流下的泪水，加上悔和恨在灰烬中凝聚而成水晶，只有这样才能看见迷茫的灵魂。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: These are tears shed from withered eye sockets, crystallized with regret and hatred among the ashes. Only through this can one see lost souls…

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 一键遥控家中所有设备，解放双手。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A single remote for every device at home. One tap is all it takes.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 仅存的半张纸，是没有结局的告白信。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A torn half-sheet of paper, bearing a confession letter that never reached its end.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 将它打乱又将它还原，一切周而复始。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Scramble it, solve it, and everything begins again.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 轻巧便捷，超强储能，更配有太阳能充电功能。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A lightweight, portable power bank with high-capacity storage and solar charging.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 万千海水汇聚于此，凝结出大海的心脏。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Countless waves seem to gather within it, forming a blue as deep as the heart of the sea.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 可随身携带的感应灯，照亮前方的道路。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A portable motion-sensing light that brightens the path ahead.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 无愧于「大将军」之名的招牌超大章鱼烧。整只章鱼霸气入料，颗颗软糯弹牙，鲜味十足，即使是「章鱼」亲手制作的章鱼烧，论风味也与之难分高下。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A signature super-sized takoyaki worthy of the "Taishou" title. Made with whole octopus for maximum impact, each piece is soft, chewy, and bursting with fresh flavor. Even takoyaki made by an actual octopus would be hard-pressed to match this incredible taste.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 必不可少的家具摆件。黑色的结状雕塑，富有艺术气息，提升家居格调。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An essential furniture ornament. A black knot-shaped sculpture with artistic flair, enhancing your home's sophistication.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 必不可少的家具摆件。黑色的环状雕塑，富有艺术气息，提升家居格调。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An essential furniture ornament. A black ring-shaped sculpture with artistic flair, enhancing your home's sophistication.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 双人份的分享装，当然也可以一个人吃完。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A two-flavor treat meant for sharing. Of course, keeping it all to yourself is also an option.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 百花夺春。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A paperweight graced with spring blossoms, as if a hundred flowers had bloomed within it.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 千枫染秋。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A paperweight painted in maple red, as if autumn itself had been dyed by a thousand leaves.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 细小的白钻，如同海边的白沙，历经打磨才会变得耀眼。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Tiny white diamonds polished to a dazzling gleam, like pale sand along a moonlit shore.

CollectionDesc.SourceString:
覆盖棘刺的海洋生物。
看起来攻击性极强，味道也确实很不错，究竟是谁发现这种东西居然是可以吃的呢？
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString:
A spiny marine creature.
It looks extremely aggressive, but it actually tastes quite good. Who was the first person brave enough to find out it was edible?

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 落在后面的车手，只能吃尾气了……如果是幽灵车，连尾气都没有。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Racers who fall behind can only eat exhaust fumes… but if it's a ghost racer, there's not even exhaust fumes left for you.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 尚未打开的「C」，请克制住好奇心。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The "C" remains unopened—for now. Best keep your curiosity under control.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 落日熔金，坠在耳畔，摇碎满帘旧时光。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: As if sunset had melted into gold and come to rest by the ear, it gleams with memories of days gone by.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 卡厄斯执意要把这碗不含任何海鲜成分的饭称作「海鲜饭」，甚至不惜改口说自己的名字就叫「海鲜」。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Chaos insists on calling this bowl of rice, which contains absolutely no seafood, "seafood paella"—even going so far as to claim that his own name is "Seafood."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 那是最后一抹红霞的颜色，微小却足够夺目。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A tiny diamond touched by the last blush of the evening clouds—small, yet impossible to overlook.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 扭蛋里是什么？只有打开后才知道。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: What's inside? You won't know until you open it.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 伤心英雄的胸膛里，跳动着孩童时期最柔软的幻想。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The softest dreams of childhood still beat within Saddy Teddy's chest.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 一起来玩球吧！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A springy little ball made for fun, games, and a bit of mischief.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 一颗甜甜的金平糖，希望今天也是甜甜的。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A glittering little candy that makes today feel a bit sweeter.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 可以增加幸福感的家装。全面屏设计，搭载智能操作系统，是闲暇时消磨时间的不错选择。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Furniture that boosts your mood. Featuring a full‑screen display and a smart operating system, this TV is a nice way to pass the time.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 出自名家之手的艺术画作，是众多收藏家所注目的焦点，价值不菲。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A masterpiece by a renowned artist, the center of attention for many collectors and worth a considerable sum.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「珠宝不语，却比任何语言都打动人心。」某位著名作家如是说。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: "Jewelry speaks no words, yet it moves the heart more than any language." So said a famous writer.

CollectionDesc.SourceString:
柔软漂亮的浮游生物。
水母没有心脏，它们从水里诞生，最终也和海水融为一体。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString:
A soft, beautiful planktonic creature.
Jellyfish have no hearts. Born of water, they return to the sea in the end.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: xxxx年xx月xx日，xx时xx分xx秒，7斤7两，谢谢大家的祝福……不要问我在哪钓的。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: XXXX-XX-XX, XX:XX:XX, 5 kg. Don't ask where, don't ask how. I fished it. Thanks for your praise.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「方盒科技」近期推出的最新款手机，功能较以往有了很大优化，副作用是有了更强的成瘾性。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The latest phone released by Cubox Technologies features significant improvements over previous models. The side effect of these upgrades is being even more addictive.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 红鲤鱼蓝鲤鱼与绿鲤鱼。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Red carp, blue carp, and green carp.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「曾属于某位流亡的君王。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: "It once belonged to a king in exile."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 赌徒紧握在手中的最后一枚方斯，对于玛门来说是不错的零食。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The last Fons clutched tightly in a gambler's hand makes for a nice snack for Mammon.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 所谓的英雄，就是要战胜一切邪恶！心猎铁骑L1系列手办，绝赞售卖中！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A true hero is one who defeats all evildoers! Kokoro Rider L1 series figurine, now for sale!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「番茄酱暴走现场实录！」任务道具
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: "Tomato Jelly Rampage: Live Report!" Quest Item

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 外观奇特的瓷瓶，很难根据外表判断出它的用途是什么，嗯……仅供观赏怎么不算是一种用途呢？
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A porcelain vase with a peculiar appearance. It's hard to tell what it's used for at just a glance. Hmm… but isn't being nice to look at a purpose in itself?

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 怀揣着与信念毫无二异的梦想，船头的水手由此望向以前从未有人到达的世界尽头。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Carrying dreams as steadfast as their convictions, sailors at the bow would gaze through this and glimpse the edge of the world, where none had ventured before.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 试用者匿名评价：「我严重怀疑塔吉多是为了谋害我才把这个闹钟送给我的！！！」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Rated by an anonymous tester: I have a strong feeling that Taygedo gave me this alarm clock just to make me suffer!!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 摆出奇怪造型的暴走棉绒绒。外观狂放不羁，但手感很好。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Gigafluff striking a bizarre pose. It looks wild and unrestrained but feels great to touch.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 色彩斑斓的褪色票根，孤独少女的存在证明。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A colorful yet faded ticket stub, proof of a lonely girl's existence.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「曾属于某位流亡的君王。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: "It once belonged to a king in exile."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「曾属于某位流亡的君王。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: "It once belonged to a king in exile."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 悬赏奖金和战利品全都要，这才是一个合格的异象猎人。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Taking both the bounty and the spoils of war—that's what makes a true Anomaly Hunter.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 所谓的英雄，就是要肩负一切责任！心猎铁骑L2系列手办，绝赞售卖中！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A true hero is one who shoulders everything! Kokoro Rider L2 series figurine, now for sale!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 所谓的英雄，就是要守护一切梦想！心猎铁骑L3系列手办，绝赞售卖中！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A true hero is one who protects every dream! Kokoro Rider L3 series figurine, now for sale!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 他的血，肉甚至于灵魂都献给了他曾效忠的主人。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: His blood, flesh, and even his soul were all offered to the master he once served.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 见效极快的止痛药，无论是头痛还是脚痛，只需一粒，药到病除。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Fast-acting pain relief. One pill clears any ache—from headaches to sore feet.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 某宠物用品厂商最新研发的宠物头部按摩神器。据说没有一只爱宠能够在它的魔爪下还能够保持理智。「哼！汪们绝不会向这东西低头！」「继续、继续！不要停！呜呼~起飞！」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A newly developed pet head massager from a pet product manufacturer. It's said that no pet can remain rational under its claws! "Hmph! We dogs will never bow to this thing!" "Arf. Woof! Keep going, keep going! Don't stop! Woohoo!"

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 如果撕下翘起的标签可以看到这个东西原本的名字：Taygedo护身喷雾，看来经过本人实验，效果有限。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Remove the warped label and you can see the original name of this item - Taygedo Protective Spray. Judging by its status quo, it has limited effect as protective equipment.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 家用型超大摆件，一键省心解决装饰烦恼。仅有黑白两色的手办，特殊图案显得神秘而富有吸引力，如同一个谜题让人想要深入探索。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A household super-sized ornament, effortlessly solving all your decoration troubles. A figurine clothed in black and white, with special patterns that tease the mind, like a riddle inviting exploration.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 刀尖断裂，铁锈层层剥落，镶嵌的装饰已被海水蚀出孔洞。刀柄缠着的布条腐蚀发黑，露出下面刻着的歪歪扭扭的小字：「杰瑞讨厌下雨，讨厌黑夜，讨厌火焰。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The tip has snapped off, rust flakes from the blade in layers, and the inlaid decorations have been eaten away by seawater. The cloth around the hilt has rotted black, revealing a crooked little inscription carved underneath: "Jerry hates rain, hates night, and hates fire."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 沸腾的蓝色火焰与深夜的轰鸣声在心脏中疯狂跳动。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Boiling blue flames and the roar of midnight beat wildly within the heart.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 清新的柠檬片与气泡水的完美结合，再加上一点点薄荷叶，带来清爽的口感。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The perfect combination of fresh lemon slices and Acqua Frizzante al Limone, with a touch of mint leaves, brings a refreshing taste.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 能满足多种使用需求的桌子。具有独特的圆锥形底座设计，稳固实用，柔化家居线条。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A table that can meet various needs. Features a unique conical base design that is stable and practical, while softening the lines of your home.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 人气邪道漫画，画风奇诡，新颖的设定和剧情为它吸引了大批粉丝。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A popular unconventional manga with a bizarre art style. Its novel setting and storylines have attracted a massive fanbase.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 以粉爪银行吉祥物为原型设计的异象摆件，有时会带来意想不到的惊喜。前提是——在粉爪银行办张卡。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An anomaly decoration designed after Pink Paws Bank's mascot, which sometimes brings unexpected surprises. The catch is—you'll need an account at PPB first.

CollectionDesc.SourceString:
向阳岛义工们手工制作的饼干，做成了最受欢迎的扭扭模样。
「每一袋饼干的盈利都将用于『一意向阳』异象福利院的建设，感谢您为海特洛市福利事业做出的贡献。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString:
Handmade cookies prepared by volunteers on Sunward Island, shaped like everyone's favorite Twisty.
"All proceeds from each bag will support the construction of the Sunward Anomaly Charity House. Thank you for supporting Hethereau's public welfare efforts."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 散发着温暖光芒的灯具。纹理细腻的灯罩，风格鲜明的灯具，需要一点审美搭配。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A lamp emanating warm light. The finely textured lampshade and distinctive style require a certain aesthetic sensibility to coordinate properly.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 鲜血，汗水，疼痛，旧伤……这些都是拳王的勋章。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Blood, sweat, pain, scars… the medals of a boxer.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 迈达斯科技公司与食品巨头贝弗瑞集团合作研发的革命性能量棒，提取多种超级食材精华与某种未被公开的异象活性成分，能显著提升异能者的长期体能。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A revolutionary energy bar developed by Midas Technologies in collaboration with the food giant Beverry Group. It is made by extracting the essence of a variety of super ingredients with a certain undisclosed anomaly active ingredient. Can significantly enhance the long-term physical performance of Espers.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 一位未来的飞镖大师，对于帮她找到飞镖的人的谢礼。拿上它吧，或许你也能成为飞镖大师！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A token of gratitude from a future dart master to whoever helped her find her dart. Take it with you—maybe you'll become a dart master too!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 睡前一颗好梦棉花糖，蓬蓬软软，涤净一天的劳累，做个好梦！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A Marshmallow before sleep eases your fatigue and brings you a sweet dream!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 隐藏头目虽不是魔王也想触碰邂逅！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Hidden Boss (But Not a Demon Lord) Seeks Fateful Encounter!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「在一千个斑斓梦境中，种下一千枚种子。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: "Plant a thousand seeds in a thousand fever dreams."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 古色古香的花瓶，不管你是考古学家还是窃贼，搬运时请务必轻拿轻放。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An antique vase with classical charm. Whether you're an archaeologist or a thief, please handle with care when carrying it.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 新越M1000，紧凑车身设计，极致灵活操纵体验，让你在城市拥堵中也游刃有余。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Novus M1000 features a compact body design with exceptional agile handling, letting you navigate through city traffic with ease.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 哦，诚实的孩子，你想要这份沾番茄酱的薯条还是这份沾圣代的薯条，还是这个最最最最最可爱的新口味薯条兽呢？
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Oh, honest child, do you want the french fries dipped in ketchup, the french fries dipped in sundae, or the super duper cutest new flavor Frizzle?

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 与同品牌的可可粉不同，至少这款抹茶粉真的是「烘焙伴侣」。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Unlike their cocoa powder, at least this matcha powder is a real Baking Buddy.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 设计新颖大胆的音乐播放器，给无聊的生活增添一抹亮眼色彩。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A music player with bold, innovative design that adds a splash of vibrant color to boring everyday life.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 小巧便携但功能齐全的游戏机，银行员工休息时常会用它消遣。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A compact yet fully featured handheld console. Bank employees use it to pass the time during breaks.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 做工细致的团三郎玩偶，憨态可掬，是送给小孩子当生日礼物的不错选择。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A finely crafted Danzaburou doll with an adorably charming appearance. It's a great choice as a birthday gift for children.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 盖满！毛茸茸头目的驯养图鉴~
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Registered! Fluffy Boss added to the Oddidex!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 阿德勒赠送的复古唱机。曾经风靡一时的唱片机，如今早已停产。作为一台老古董，阿德勒先生将它保养得很好。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A vintage record player gifted by Adler. This record player that was once all the rage, but has long since stopped production. As an antique piece, Adler has maintained it in excellent condition.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: DSD潮玩店的爆款，购买者拆箱后第一次徒手触摸会决定暴龙的颜色和质地。如果有幸摸出质地通透、颜色翠绿的暴龙，出门左转雷加利亚4s店，挑选你心仪的跑车吧。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A bestseller from DSD POP. The first bare-handed touch after unboxing determines the T-Rex's color and texture. If you're lucky enough to fish out a translucent, emerald green T-Rex, head left to the Regalia 4S dealership and pick your dream sports car!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 家中常见的健身好物。配色清新时尚的滑轮车，轻便快捷，使用它时记得戴好头盔。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A common household fitness item. Roller skates with a fresh and fashionable color scheme. Both lightweight and fast, just remember to wear your helmet while using them.

CollectionDesc.SourceString:
千代婆婆自酿的植物发酵饮品。老旧的发酵桶，一道道划痕不甚清晰地映照出少女日渐佝偻的身影……
「喂喂喂！只是麦子啊，甜水都能把你放倒？」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString:
Granny Chiyo's home-brewed, plant-fermented drink. Countless scratches can be seen on the old fermentation bucket, an explicit reflection of the Chiyo's sweat and toil… 
Hey hey hey! It's just made of wheat. How could you get drunk drinking sweet water?

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 被早雾直接在身上蹭掉吃过薯片的碎屑后，塔吉多连夜做出这个并授予娜娜莉和早雾「尝鲜免费试用权」。但购买记录显示，达芙蒂尔似乎才是第一个购入者……
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: This finger washer is made by Taygedo. Sakiri and Nanally are given free trials, all thanks to Sakiri rubbing off the potato chip crumbs on Taygedo. According to the purchase record, however, Daffodill seems to be the first buyer…

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 以诡面筝为原型设计的滑翔翼涂装，将故障风险提高了99%——不要紧张嘛，只是一个玩笑。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A glider livery designed after the Ghostly Kite, increasing the risk of malfunction by 99%… Relax, it's just a joke.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 以洄天鱼幡为原型设计的滑翔翼涂装，今日天气预报为多云转阴，出门请记得带伞。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A glider livery designed after the Skyfish Banner. Today's forecast is cloudy, possibly overcast. Don't forget your umbrella!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 必不可少的家具摆件。以柔光球体为核心，搭配优雅的环状装饰，带来静谧而神秘的视觉体验。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An essential furniture ornament. Centered around a soft light sphere and paired with elegant ringed decorations, this design brings forth a soothing and mysterious visual experience.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 白贝壳星级主厨的甜品代表作之一。外层选用上等黄油起酥，精选小布妮种植鲜橙为夹层，辅以蓝莓果酱基底。入口如天鹅羽毛般轻盈，让你体验到前所未有的清新丝滑感受。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: One of the signature desserts from a La Palourde Blanche chef. The exterior features premium butter puff pastry, with fresh oranges grown by Little Buni as the filling, complemented by a blueberry jam base. The texture is as light as swan feathers upon tasting, offering an unprecedented refreshing smoothness.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 是你家的啾啾女仆~啾！有什么问题请尽情吩咐啾~
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Your Choo-Choo maid is here. Choo! Please feel free to give me any orders.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 必不可少的家具摆件。弯月样的造型，金属的质感和光泽增添了一分温暖与高级感。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An essential furniture ornament. The crescent moon-shaped design, with its metallic texture and sheen, adds a touch of warmth and sophistication.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 依靠被嫌弃的「蒲公英技能」最终攻略了世界！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Conquered the world with the despised "Dandelion Skill"!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 传统炭火慢烤，几十年如一日的经典味道，无论是家庭聚餐，还是好友小酌，均受到除青花鱼外的所有当事人认可。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Slow-roasted with charcoal in a traditional way, this dish boasts a decades-old classic flavor. Whether it's for a family dinner or a small meal with good friends, it has received praise from all except the mackerel itself.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 外表漆黑如墨的长颈瓶，传说曾有一位贫苦作家买不起纸笔，用烧黑的木炭在家里的瓶瓶罐罐上练习写作，久而久之瓶身黑炭竟然再也无法洗去，后来人们制作出墨染瓶以示对他的纪念。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A long-necked vase with an exterior as black as ink. Legend has it that a poor writer who couldn't afford paper and pen once practiced writing on household jars and bottles using charred wood. Over time, the black char became a permanent stain. People later crafted ink-stained vases to commemorate him.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 白藏赠送的装饰品。蝴蝶飞过梦境，洒下金色的鳞粉，祝你拥有一个甜美的好梦。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: An ornament from Baicang. As butterflies flutter through dreams, they scatter golden scales, wishing you sweet dreams.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 外皮金黄酥脆，瘦肉弹牙多汁，一口下去，酥脆的油香和饱满的肉汁充盈口腔，让人欲罢不能。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Golden crispy on the outside, juicy meat on the inside! With just one bite, the crispy, savory fragrance and rich meat juices fill your mouth… You won't be able to stop eating!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 家中常见的健身好物。弹性很好的拍拍球，通常会像流星一样在球场划过。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A common household fitness item. A bouncy ball with excellent elasticity, streaking across the court like a meteor.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 散发着温暖光芒的灯具。白色圆点灯罩与红色装饰顶球的撞色设计，极具个性。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A lamp radiating warm light. The contrasting design of a white polka dot lampshade with a red decorative top sphere gives it a distinctive personality.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 干燥时像块石头，沾水后像条泥鳅。要是抓不牢，它转眼间就会溜进排水沟。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Hard as a rock when dry, slippery as an eel when wet. If you don't hold on tight, it'll slip down the drain before you know it.

CollectionDesc.SourceString:
克莱门学园三十周年校庆时，为纪念当时夺得社团大战冠军的足球社特别定制的奖杯。奖杯的持有者，足球社团的社团，本件拍品的卖方表示：
「所有拍卖所得均会无偿捐赠给海特洛市体育协会，为海特洛市的足球事业增添一份微不足道的力量。」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString:
A custom trophy designed to commemorate the soccer club that won the championship during Clement Academy's 30th anniversary celebration. The trophy's holder, the soccer club, states:
"All auction proceeds will be donated free of charge to the Hethereau Sports Association, adding our small contribution to Hethereau's soccer endeavors."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 容量巨大的镀金容器，如果放一个在家里，似乎可以将所有的杂物都收纳其中。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A gilded container of enormous capacity. If you kept one at home, you could store all your miscellaneous clutter inside it.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 方盒随身听，出门时别忘记带上一盒音乐。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Cubox Portable Player. Don't forget to bring a tape of music when you head out.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 把彼此的悄悄话都藏进海螺里，这样保质期就是永远了。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Hide your whispered secrets inside a conch shell, and they'll never expire.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 「起司」外形酷似照相机，按下快门时，可使拍摄范围内所有生物都瞬间陷入「时间停滞」状态——身体无法移动，意识陷入沉寂，恍若被囚禁于一帧静止的画面中。起司是一次性异象，使用后会立刻泯除，普通人受「起司」影响严重，定格时间可长达数十小时，且事后完全丧失记忆，只能模糊记起刺眼的闪光灯。部分异能者仅会被定格住几分钟，且能清晰回忆起拍摄前的全部细节，包括相机持有者的身份。因其潜在用途包括暗杀、逃脱和挟制，普通人无缘得见，现主要流通于地下市场的悬赏交易中。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Cheese looks just like a camera, but when you press the shutter, it instantly freezes all living beings within the shooting range in a state of time suspension. Their bodies cannot move and their consciousness falls silent, as if trapped within a single frozen frame. Cheese is a one-time-use Anomaly that immediately disappears after use. Ordinary people are severely affected by Cheese, with freeze duration lasting up to dozens of hours, and they completely lose their memory afterward, only vaguely recalling a blinding flash. Some Espers are only frozen for a few minutes and can clearly recall all details before the shot, including the identity of the camera holder. Due to its potential uses including assassination, escape, and hostage situations, ordinary people have no access to it, and it currently circulates mainly in underground market bounty trades.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 出自名家之手的艺术画作，是众多收藏家所注目的焦点，价值不菲。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A masterpiece by a renowned artist, the center of attention for many collectors and worth a considerable sum.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 出自名家之手的艺术画作，是众多收藏家所注目的焦点，价值不菲。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A masterpiece by a renowned artist, the center of attention for many collectors and worth a considerable sum.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 会自动寻找蟑螂的蟑螂型自动机器人，在发现蟑螂后会自动发出警报（PS.仍需人力灭蟑），不过抗击打能力方面可能有些欠缺……
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A cockroach automaton that tracks cockroaches automatically. It will sound an alarm if it finds them (targets still need to be crushed manually). However, it is vulnerable to strikes…

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 畅爽系列向前迈出的新一步，来自高峰的雪山融水，畅爽，不仅仅是饮料！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A new step taken by the Refresh series. Melt water from the snowy high peaks, more than just a beverage!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 粗糙如砂纸，坚硬如像钢板。每个躺在上面的夜晚，它所造成的痛苦都会让你更深刻地反省自己的罪行。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Rough as sandpaper and hard as a steel plate. Every night you spend lying on it, the pain will help you reflect more deeply on your crimes.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 光滑的禽类的卵，上面粘着一点泥土，一点草屑，或许还带着生命还未真正开始时就酝酿起的温度。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Freshly laid poultry eggs, with traces of mud and grass still clinging to them. They might even still hold a hint of warmth!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 拘留所里最有效的交际工具，也是不少人被关禁闭的直接原因。放轻松，这只是个游戏！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The most effective social tool in the detention center, and also the direct cause of many landing in solitary. Relax, it's just a game!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 如春花花瓣一样柔然的石头，恰好能濯去尘埃。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A stone as soft as spring flower petals, perfect for scraping away dust.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 古韵悠长的青花瓷碗，在遥远的过去曾作为不可缺少的日用品构建着人们热气腾腾的生活。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A blue and white porcelain bowl with a timeless, classical charm. In the distant past, it served as an indispensable everyday item, a part of people's warm and vibrant lives.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 异象在被泯除后掉落的沙状物质，如果不快速收集的话很快便会消失。尽管拥有完全不合规的异象编号却没有任何有关该物质的记述，亦无法用语言描述它的特征，当人长时间注视该物质时甚至会因为涌入脑中的大量信息而感到眩晕。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A sand-like substance dropped when Anomalies are nullified, which quickly disappears if not collected promptly. Despite having a completely non-standard Anomaly designation, there are no records about this substance, nor can its properties be described in words. Those who gaze at it for extended periods may experience dizziness due to the flood of information rushing into their minds.

CollectionDesc.SourceString:
被捕捉到的微弱絮语。

「……克服失群者@#%怪谲……
……摧毁*^$异禀?#@!!$ ……」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString:
Captured faint whispers.

"…overcome the lost ones @#%aberration…
…destroy *^$anomaly?#@!!$…"

CollectionDesc.SourceString:
被捕捉到的自边缘处逐渐消退的掠影。

「Tthhe qquuickk brrownn ffoxx jumpps oveer thhe lazzy dogg.」
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString:
Captured fading silhouette from the edge.

"Tthhe qquuickk brrownn ffoxx jumpps oveer thhe lazzy dogg."

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 极致冷感，瞬间爆发，劲爽冰川，激浪一夏。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A burst of extreme coldness, as if gulping down the glacier.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 咔滋咔滋，爱来自咕比奇！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: The crunching sound is the love from Gubichi!

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 酷辣辣辣条，潮流新款，大块才够味！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: Brand-new, trendy spicy strip. Light your taste buds ablaze with a mouthful of it.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 一种具有特殊的高度不稳定性的物质，你永远不知道下一次查看它时它会变成什么。
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: A substance with highly unstable special properties. You never know what it will become the next time you view it.

CollectionDesc.SourceString: 弹珠可以再买，能偷偷吃辣条的机会可不多！
CollectionDesc.LocalizedString: You can always buy more marbles, but the chance to secretly munch on spicy sticks don't come around often!
